source_profile.provenance: Locally authored from scratch by the focused C++ selector at runtime; generated drawings are removed with the temporary directory.

contract.dwg: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.22 defines the common DIMENSION DIMSTYLE field as a hard pointer.
contract.dxf: Autodesk Common Dimension Group Codes defines group 3 as the dimension style name.
contract.required_projection: Resolve a non-null DWG DIMSTYLE pointer to the exact table name. Preserve STANDARD for a null model pointer. If a non-null pointer has no table target, keep the group-3 name unresolved and refuse strict full conversion rather than emitting an empty or substituted style.

implementation.reader: dwgReader::resolveDimensionTableReferences retains STANDARD for a null DIMSTYLE handle and maps other handles through the DIMSTYLE table; an absent non-null target remains an empty style name.
implementation.writer: dxfRW::preflightDimensionStyle now rejects an empty style name during strict full conversion before opening the DIMENSION record scope. Direct standalone writer behavior remains outside this strict check.
implementation.test: The focused selector runtime-authors valid and missing-target AC1024 DWGs, imports both, checks exact custom-name resolution or unresolved empty name, then verifies ASCII/Binary strict refusal, destination preservation, same-adapter correction retry, and typed readback.

results.resolved_custom_style: PASS: ANSI-25 survives AC1024 DWG import and ASCII/Binary DXF output/readback.
results.missing_target: PASS: the generated non-null missing DIMSTYLE target remains unresolved after adapter retention and strict output refuses it.
results.rollback_and_retry: PASS: existing destination sentinels survive both refusals; setting the resolved DIMSTYLE name allows the same adapter to write and read back ANSI-25 in both encodings.

sources.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.22 Common Dimension Data

claim_boundary: Generated AC1024 DIMENSION DIMSTYLE name transport and fail-closed behavior only. No physical producer breadth, dimension rendering, native-consumer behavior, or general support claim is established.
